description: Bunker CO2 account 'co2 bunkers ASEAN': same Store contract as the national atmospheres; final level <= 0 on its own (hook research_bunker_net_zero, row research_bunker_co2_limit, gate B1_BUNKERS); every port is an emission port (validate_bunker_account refuses removals), so no country's negative emissions are transferred (decision 9) and fossil bunker fuel is 0 in any feasible solution - the account is met with non-fossil kerosene (FT, BtL, electrobiofuels, FT import) and methanol
